figma_source.canonical_section: Section 3 (322:1156). Everything outside Sections 3 and 4 is exploration and must not be used.

web_source.note: Square Online renders client-side, so an automated fetch returns only meta tags. Web patterns below come from the homepage build (11 custom blocks under the .glyh namespace). Verify against the live page.

facts.do_not_hardcode_reason: These change. Pull from facts.md at draft time and flag for human check before posting.
facts.descriptor_long: Premium simulator bays, coworking, and curated events in San Rafael, CA

tagline.text: Where Golf Lives Beyond the Course

facts.logo_descriptor: SIMULATOR LOUNGE / MARIN CALIFORNIA (logo lockup only, not for captions)

bays.retired_reason: No name rights. Never use in any content. The Figma floor plan still shows it.

subtagline.text: Love the Game. Live the Hang.

tagline_alternates: Respect the Game. Redefine the Experience.

primary: Younger professionals, late 20s to 50s, with disposable income
Golf enthusiasts from serious players to social golfers
People who want community without a traditional club membership
Dads and busy parents who need golf to fit their lives
secondary: High schoolers interested in tech-enabled training
Older golfers who value tradition and embrace innovation
Families looking for clinics and events

facts.positioning: The intersection of sport and lifestyle. A modern extension of the golf course, never a replacement. Own the off-course golf category.
value_props: Accessibility: golf anytime, whatever the weather, daylight or schedule
Innovation: data-rich play and swing tracking
Community: a third space for local sports, events, merch and socializing
Premium but fun: modern design with cheeky nods to golf and local culture

chalk_white.role: Page and document background. Text and logo on footage.
chalk_white.note: A whisper of the Flagpole hue (24 degrees), the same way Shade Black is a near-black rather than #000000. golfery.com cards use #FFFFFF today; if this is adopted, update the site cards to match.

golfery_green.role: Primary. Backgrounds, headlines on light, logo.

flagpole_white.role: Warm surface. Panels, cards, post backgrounds. Text on green or black.

accent_purple.role: Accent, and the coworking color. Labels, pills, banners, coworking cards. Never as text on green.

shade_black.role: Dark backgrounds, body text on light.

pairings_approved.use: any text size, and the default over a footage scrim
large text and labels only, 56px and up
large text and labels only, 56px and up
large text and labels only, 56px and up
bold or large text only, as on the site's purple banner and coworking cards

pairings_banned.reason: Unreadable as text. Purple shapes beside green are fine, as with the Most Popular pill. The Practice Round page sets a purple text line on green; change it to Flagpole White.
No separation. Fine as adjacent surfaces, never as text on background.
No separation as text. Fine as a cream panel on the white page, with a hairline border.
No separation as text. Fine as a grey panel on the white page.

usage_ratio.rule: Instagram frame: about 60 percent green or Flagpole White, 30 percent the other, 10 percent or less purple. Black is for dark variants and Reel caption bars. White is text and logo on footage. Web and documents: white page, Flagpole White and grey panels, green blocks.

on_photo_text.rule: Text over photo or video is white on a shade_black gradient scrim, 0 to 60 percent opacity, bottom up. Flagpole White is the alternate. Never place green or purple text directly on footage.

surface_order.rule: Chalk White is the page. Flagpole White and Hazy Grey sit on it as panels. Green and black are full-bleed blocks. Instagram frames still lead with green or Flagpole White so the feed stays warm; white there is for text and logo on footage.

white_options.label: Pure white, what golfery.com cards use today

category_colors.rule: Offers are color coded. Keep the code on Instagram so a follower can tell the category before reading.

map.golf: flagpole_white card, shade_black and green text
map.membership_featured: golfery_green card with a purple pill

display.role: Headlines. Italic for one closing phrase at most.

scale_1080.note: Pixel sizes on a 1080px wide canvas. A phone renders this at roughly one third scale, so 36px is the legibility floor.

type.source_note: Weights match the golfery.com font load: Playfair Display 500, 600 and 500 italic; Archivo 400 to 700; IBM Plex Mono 400, 500. Hannah's earlier font options (Montserrat, Inter, DM Sans, Merriweather, Libre Baskerville, Sohne) are retired.
notes: Prices are set in Playfair Display, as on the pricing page. Sim stats, dates and codes stay in IBM Plex Mono.
Eyebrows on the pricing page read as Archivo, bold, wide tracking, while the homepage uses IBM Plex Mono. Instagram uses Plex Mono. Worth unifying the site to one.

layout.note: Instagram moves its UI chrome often. Verify safe zones against the live app each quarter.

feed_portrait.use: Default for all feed posts and carousels

grid_crop.rule: Profile grid shows a 3:4 center crop. Keep headline and logo inside the center 1080x1440 of a Reel cover, and inside the center 1012px width of a 4:5 post.

layout.logo_clearspace: Height of the G in the wordmark on all sides
layout.corner_radius_note: 24px matches the site cards. Pills are fully rounded.

logo.description: Hand-lettered script wordmark 'Golfery' with an underline swash that ends in a club head. Optional descriptor lockup below it.

marks.use: Primary mark. Default for covers, end cards, announcements.
First-touch contexts only: ads, partner posts, anything a non-follower sees first.
Small spaces: Story header chip, watermark-size credits, favicon.
Story hero over footage, merch, stickers, profile avatar candidate.
Rare. Pair with symbol when the wordmark will not fit.

colorways_for_instagram.on_footage: Chalk White, matching the site hero. Flagpole White is the alternate.
colorways_for_instagram.purple_logo: Exists in Figma. Merch and one-offs only. Never on green.
colorways_for_instagram.pure_black: Exists in Figma. Use Shade Black instead.

clearspace.rule: Wordmark 727x440 sits in a 935x612 box: about 14 percent of logo width on left and right, about 20 percent of logo height on top and bottom. Nothing enters that box.

exports_needed.format: SVG plus PNG at 2x, transparent background
exports_needed.how: In Figma, select each variant in Section 3, outline the text-on-path in the badge first, then Export. Use Cleanspace=false variants so templates control padding.
exports_needed.white_shortcut: No Figma trip needed: copy each green SVG and replace fill="#345C2C" with fill="#FFFAF7". README has the one-line command.

rules: Wordmark max 60 percent of canvas width as a hero, max 20 percent as a sign-off
Sign-off placement: bottom center or bottom left inside the 72px margin
Never retype the wordmark in a font. It is lettering, always use the vector.
Never set headlines in a script face to imitate the logo
No shadows, outlines, gradients, rotation, stretching, or off-palette recolors
Carousel: first and last slide only. Reels: cover and end card only. No persistent watermark.

web_patterns.site_section_use: These nine sections are ready-made content pillars for the weekly plan.

workflow.rule: Claude drafts to /drafts. Kel or Hannah moves work to /approved. Nothing posts without one of them.
workflow.reference_imagery: No reference post set. Use the golfery.com photography as the visual benchmark.

consent.members: Covered. The agreement grants Golfery the right to use member name, image, likeness and voice in marketing and social media.
consent.opt_outs: Members can opt out of staged marketing content in writing. Keep the list in facts.md and check it before featuring anyone by name or as the subject.
consent.guests_and_drop_ins: Not covered by the member agreement. Ask on the day, or confirm the guest waiver includes a media release.
consent.minors: Junior members are covered through the guardian signature. Any other minor needs a guardian yes before being the subject of a post.
consent.rule: Only 'unknown' plus a recognizable face as the subject blocks a post. Background and crowd appearances are fine.

alcohol.rule: Drink content can be front and center.
alcohol.note: If a drink-forward post is boosted as an ad, set the audience to 21 and over.
